entries.notes: Issue #17 closed and PR #36 merged on 2026-09-20. The validator is implemented; SPIKE_READY still describes contract maturity, not issue status. docs/issue-17-review-repair-handoff.md is a historical review record.

Task transitions commit with material provenance. Writable startup requires kernel-held exclusive store ownership plus a durable monotonic fencing epoch; RECOVERING is entered only through the private trusted coordinator.
Published Artifacts are immutable; staging/blob/metadata crash cases are specified.

Tamper-evident local journal, not tamper-proof against a privileged full-store rewrite. The event payload schema encodes event-specific detail keys and 512-item Artifact/reference bounds while journal-envelope hashes remain outside the payload. Portable export is a separately hashed privacy-redacted projection with bundle-local aliases; offline verification proves only the exported projection and neither original-chain validity nor linkage.

entries.workstream: Semantic registry snapshots and provider registration/conformance
entries.notes: Semantic meaning registry remains separate from implementation/provider availability. Additive 0014 records an append-only repair generation, terminal admissions, historically unprovable legacy admissions, all activation scope identities since healthy bootstrap, and invalidated scopes. Missing stamped semantic guards fence executable use until explicit owner-bound strict re-attestation with a fresh local decision/source; old binding markers remain quarantined and terminal or unprovable admissions cannot be rehabilitated. If activation history was already unprovable before 0014 bootstrap, a durable global quarantine blocks all new activations pending future explicit migration. Immutable semantic identities and prior migration stamps remain unchanged. Issue #3 policy-engine decision integration is future work.

entries.workstream: Immutable Execution Binding and bounded provider invocation
entries.notes: Implementation should initially use one deterministic local fixture provider, not a general distributed runtime. Stage-1 spike tightened new binding receipts to require exact provider/build/contract identities, a conformance evidence pin, and an effective trust-source pin; earlier nullable or unpinned receipts remain historical and cannot launch through the stamped provider gate. A durable insert guard validates registration, manifest/build projection, and public provider fields before consuming an attempt. The internal immutable enablement marker pins a monotonic state epoch across equal-time disable/re-enable; expiring evidence must outlive binding creation. Full RFC 3339 offsets are compared as UTC instants, and exhausted epoch revisions fail closed. Stamped ledger repair disables prior registered intervals and quarantines old bindings without changing public binding JSON or AIOS IR.
System derives certainty independently for each recovery subject and preserves OUTCOME_UNKNOWN rather than optimistic Task-level inference or universal exactly-once claims.
